data.narrative:
Precision AI, founded by Daniel McCann, is a Series A-stage company operating in the Drones & Autonomous sector. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 8 private-market comparables in the sector, including peers such as Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air. No public comparables exist in this narrow subsector. The company has raised $20M to date.

Given the nascent state of the peer set, only one valuation method proved applicable. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $20M total raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, yielding an implied valuation of $40M. Peer-Median analysis was not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum sample size thresholds (fewer than 3 datapoints across narrow filters), making broad sector-level medians unreliable.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $34M (low) to $46M (high), with a median of $40M. This single-method range reflects inherent uncertainty: the lack of robust peer-stage data limits confidence in the multiplier assumption, and early-stage drone and autonomous companies exhibit wide valuation dispersion based on technology differentiation and customer traction rather than financial metrics. Key uncertainties center on customer pipeline maturity, regulatory pathway clarity, and the company's burn rate relative to raised capital.
